scope: Two separate Worker roles. Wallet-derived canonical key generation and twelve fresh signing candidates precede readiness. The client-timed signing request includes later candidate table reads, protocol exchanges, completion acknowledgements, and Worker verification. The first table group is resident before readiness. Direct uniform nonce sampling replaces the FIPS hedged nonce procedure.
limits: The first fresh table group is loaded before admission, and its cost is included in readiness. Online time includes the start message, later R2 reads, protocol exchanges, and completion. This is a live resident reservation; cold or empty pools have no five-second success claim.

Native fixture generation derives owner roots from known disposable wallet seeds. Workers receive only their root shares and execute root-to-canonical-key derivation. Production custody envelopes, admission, durable activation, and pool restart are not implemented.
Cf colo fields describe request metadata. They do not independently establish each physical compute or storage placement.
